description:
Electric Mini Bike – Super Fun Step Through
The DJ Super Bike Step Thru – Our retro-style fat tire step through electric bike is back and better than ever. The redesigned electric mini bike from DJ Bikes Canada now includes the back rack super bike enthusiasts have been asking for. This easy step through electric bike was created for both comfort and adventure whether you’re on and off road. An easy rider that’s perfectly balanced with an easy step through frame, a banana-style, cushioned seat, adjustable handlebars and suspension to absorb shocks to keep you comfortable on and off road. Plus the 20” fat tires wrapped around alloy spokeless wheels provide strength and stability that begs for a fun adventure. 5 levels of pedal assist puts the power right into your pedal stroke or simply throttle the 500W of power on demand.
The DJ Super Bike is the best value electric bike in this category. This redesigned mini-bike sports a new rear rack, integrated headlight and tail light, front and rear fenders, and more–all included in the base price. It’s powerful 48V Samsung battery can be dismounted and charged anywhere on the go and the charger has a safety design to prevent over-charged. Step into this easy rider, your super-charged adventure awaits.

components.description: Tektro brand (Tektro disc MD-M280 or Nutt S-5; Tektro pads MD-M300)
Samsung brand cells Lithium-ion 48V 13Ah, 624Wh, removable battery pack with battery lock, mounted under seat
Charging System: 120-240V with LED light status display, with UL approved for North America
New version SHENGTENG LCD display with 5 speed pedals assist function, speed indicator, backlight, local time, top riding speed, riding distance
Powerful, Jiabo rated watt 48V 500W brushless rear hub motor
Alloy aluminum with suspension, MOZO brand, adjustable pressure
high quality hand grips, double colours
LED, integrated in the battery box
High quality cushion saddle, New design and integrated material, more comfortable 600mm (23.62 in) X 190 mm (7.48 in)
